recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-5830; future changes to the mandatory required status binding should be handled under a new work-group decision because FHIR-55281 explicitly rejected adding an escape-valve code.
issue_request: FHIR-5830 was a Published FHIR-core VisionPrescription change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking to add a status to VisionPrescription comparable to MedicationPrescription status. The final resolution states that status had already been added to all Financial Management resources for STU3.
initial_application: No current git commit explicitly mentions FHIR-5830. Commit ba29243912d2adb5ec994767eb45f6428c9f2bd7 is the matching historical application: it added VisionPrescription.status, made it 1..1, marked it as modifier/summary, added active statuses to examples, and introduced the initial VisionStatus code list. Commit 5de20f17514c0d3beb1c87841a9ee24d189cb8b2 then consolidated VisionStatus to the shared fm-status value set.
additional_context: VisionPrescription remains in current build scope through active source/fhir.ini entries. The current StructureDefinition has VisionPrescription.status as a required 1..1 modifier code bound required to ValueSet/fm-status, the resource introduction links to the Financial Resource Status Lifecycle, and a status search parameter exists. Later FHIR-55281 was resolved No Change/Not Persuasive, confirming that the required status binding should not gain an unknown/other escape valve without a new cross-version decision. FHIR-17980 separately covered financial status lifecycle documentation links for resources including VisionPrescription.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current authoritative XML and related source surfaces already satisfy the final FHIR-5830 decision, and later history explains why the current shared fm-status code set differs from the original MedicationPrescription-style wording.
